title: Editorial Prestige DESIGN.md in YAML Frontmatter Mode
prompt: Generate a production-ready DESIGN.md for 'Chronicle Press' using the editorial-prestige archetype in YAML frontmatter mode. Ensure all 8 canonical sections are present, every color token is referenced, and all component foreground/background pairs pass WCAG AA contrast.

title: Atmospheric Minimal Dark UI DESIGN.md in Interleaved YAML Mode
prompt: Generate a DESIGN.md for 'Pulse Telemetry' using the atmospheric-minimal archetype with interleaved YAML code blocks inside each markdown section.

title: Audit and Remediate Linter Errors in DESIGN.md
prompt: Audit a DESIGN.md file that contains `colours:` instead of `colors:`, a broken `{colors.brand-accent}` reference, an orphaned color token, and a low-contrast button (`#9ca3af` on `#ffffff`). Report the exact @google/design.md lint rule IDs and fix them.

title: Export DESIGN.md Tokens to Tailwind v4 CSS and W3C DTCG JSON
prompt: Compile our DESIGN.md tokens into a Tailwind v4 `@theme` CSS file and a W3C DTCG `tokens.json` file with all `{path.to.token}` references resolved.

title: Upgrade Pure-Prose Google Stitch Export to Hybrid DESIGN.md
prompt: Convert a narrative-only Google Stitch DESIGN.md export into a hybrid @google/design.md specification with normative YAML tokens and the 8 canonical sections.

expected_elements.extracted_palette: Hydrates primary, secondary, tertiary, neutral, and surface tokens from inline hex codes
expected_elements.canonical_section_mapping: Maps Visual Theme & Atmosphere -> ## Overview, Color Palette & Roles -> ## Colors, Component Stylings -> ## Components
